review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source image with nine evenly spaced decoded frames in the erosion-negative Wan 2.7 contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Rechecked the recorded MP4 digest, byte size, dimensions, duration, frame count, frame rate and audio flag.

observations.requested_motion: The central purple aura should steadily erode outside-in and lose opacity, ending as a small faint halo without growth, bloom, pulse or rebound.
observations.camera: Fixed camera and full square framing throughout.
invariant_failures: The purple aura first intensifies and grows into a saturated bloom before fading; its area and opacity do not decrease monotonically.

verdict.summary: The diagram remains legible, but the aura grows and brightens before it fades, contradicting the requested outside-in monotonic erosion.
